title: guard.overridden@1
description: A call DeepBuild denied at PreToolUse ran anyway (#1033): its PostToolUse or PostToolUseFailure arrived for the same tool-use ID, as when a Claude Code mod's tool.check approved it past the deny. The session's claims can't pass on its own evidence, and a send among them raises one ask.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

call.description: The agent's ID for the call, as its tool.before has it.

label.description: The call as a person reads it: a shell call's command, an MCP call's server and tool, or a file call's paths.

guard.description: What denied it: the guard entries in rules.json by name, or the gate's rule.

send.description: Whether the call sends: a push, a merge, a dispatch, a send or a delete, which may already have left.

mods.description: The mods of the session's Claude Code home that handle tool.check, any of which could have approved it.

mods_unread.description: Why the home's mods couldn't be read, so mods may be short; null when they were read.
